text_block_list.text:
“—Autumn. Just like Agnes Digital, King 
Halo also began preparations for the Mile 
CS, but...”
(WOOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oh! King Halo sinks to 7th place! She 
showed a flash of brilliance, but is her 
complete revival still far off?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, wheeze*...! Ugh, how could 
someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, King-san...

The road to recovery was only halfway 
complete. And so, the crowds left the 
racecourse—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: King-san, um...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You came to watch, Digital-san. Leave me 
alone.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...is what I'd like to say, but seeing as 
it's you of all people, I'll grant you the 
privilege of staying with me."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Umm... er... today is!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Though you didn't quite take first, I was 
once again in awe of your incredible 
talent, King-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Her late burst of sharpness that shines in 
sprints, the elegance in her stride, and 
her magnificent cornering!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Really now, this is what first-rate is 
all about! I truly felt that King-san is 
the first of first-rates!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So please, I beg of you...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Is that the only reason you felt I was 
first-rate?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no! No no no, there's more! Her 
flowing hair! The carrying power of her 
hearty laugh! The flair of her racing 
silks, the gluteus maximus... oh wait, not 
that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* You sure come up with plenty... 
Still, those are all just trivial details.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In order to be first-rate, there is 
something more important than anything 
else...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Digital-san. Since we're here, why 
don't we run the course together?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm going all out. There's no 
one else around now, so I can run freely.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

Having obtained permission, the two had a 
mock race. And then—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, sigh, kh*...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: King-san...

King Halo was defeated without any 
standout moments. Given her exhausted body 
after the race, it was inevitable.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: F-Fufufufu, how pathetic.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Digital-san, how do I look right now? 
Lacking sharpness, elegance, and 
grace—just an exhausted, worn-out Uma 
Musume...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Not a single proof of being first-rate 
remains. In that case, it means I'm not 
first-rate after all, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uh, w-well, that is...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A pathetic sore loser who got easily 
twisted around even by an Umamusume still 
in the Classic tier...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, even if I'm a shadow of a loser 
right now—
The twilight dusk stirred sluggishly.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What if... I were to run again tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"If you lose tomorrow, but run again the 
day after, what then?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if they keep losing, what if they 
stand back up again and again... until 
they finally win?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look at me, Digital-san. Does current 
me—really have nothing left?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eep...! N-No...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Something still remains! Like the guiding 
light of the ghost ship, the Flying 
Dutchman, something that will never waver!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What is—that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—An indomitable tenacity. A spirit that 
refuses to stay down, no matter how hard 
it is beaten.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, no one can ever tear this tenacity 
away from me."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The number of times I've been brought to 
my knees is different. The times I've been 
laughed at, the times I've been made a 
fool of—it's completely different.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because I declared myself to be 
first-rate, I have tasted defeat more than 
anyone, changed myself each time, and 
risen back to my feet.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how deep the rock bottom, never 
doubt hope!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That is the very reason why King will 
always be first-rate! "

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooooh... King...-san...!

Battered and exhausted. Even so, King Halo 
looked beautiful.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Digital-san, do you understand now? The 
true me. The reason why I am King.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I have heard your words... and 
taken them... to heart...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Did you understand? What it truly means 
for an Umamusume to run?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Yes... I can't afford to feel 
inferior. This is no time to be feeling 
down!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Whether you miss the start 
or stumble, there's nothing that can't be 
made up for!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I will definitely regain the 
form I had in my prime before the Mile 
CS."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"If you take pity on me and tell me you 
cannot run at your best, then..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's utterly rude. Both to a first-rate 
lady like myself, and to your own talent.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes... I had it all wrong!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I have received... a piece of the 
first-rate. I shall hold this close to my 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll devote myself to training until the 
Mile CS! So I won't bring shame to King!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I thought that when things got serious, I 
shouldn't act like such a fangirl 
anymore... But... just for right now..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You truly are... a goddess.

Agnes Digital clasped her hands in 
worship. Though she looked somewhat 
comical— she held an unshakeable 
reverence.
